title: ABC: Stiff and Clumsy
content: Wednesday is the day for our group sketch game called "Art By Committee." I present an actual excerpt from a science fiction manuscript and you illustrate it.This week’s quote had a specific description of a raging female, and you came up with a variety of wonderful and creative solutions.Mei-Yi ChunPatrick WaughAndy WalesChristoffer Gertz BechPaul BozzoMadelineCarol MatzMichael GeisslerKerry LacknerJen Zeller....and the one from the original sketchbook.May I suggest we take a break from the game next week? I feel privileged to host it, and I'm always amazed by your amazing solutions, but I'll be a little tight on time next week.
